name: AJAX Placeholder
description: Provides an 'ajax_placeholder' render element that renders a lightweight placeholder first, then replaces itself with the real content via a follow-up AJAX request.
project_description: The AJAX Placeholder module provides a render element that defers loading its content to a follow-up AJAX request, similar to how lazy builders and BigPipe work. A developer places an 'ajax_placeholder' element with a '#callback' in any render array; the initial page render only emits a small placeholder (a container showing optional '#markup', default 'Loading...'), and a JavaScript behaviour then fetches the real content from '/ajax/placeholder/{hash}' and swaps it in. Because the expensive/uncacheable content is excluded from the initial render, page caching and perceived performance improve. Unlike BigPipe, the placeholder requests load in parallel and asynchronously, which helps pages that render many independent, hard-to-cache fragments such as dashboards. The module requires no configuration and is aimed at developers who build custom render arrays.
